answer: Farming becomes a voyage bet on surviving 102 epochs of grading, and every tide settlement recomputes the jade schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 16 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 102 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 2 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
